description: Hand the live profile to the person at the computer for a sign-in, 2FA code, CAPTCHA or other step you must not do yourself. Browz pauses automation, raises the profile window and notifies them; this call waits (with progress) until they click I'm done, cancel, or timeoutSec passes, then you continue in the same session. Never ask the person for passwords or codes and never use CAPTCHA-solving services. After it returns, take a new browz_snapshot.

doneWhenUrlContains.description: Also finish as soon as a tab's URL contains this (e.g. /dashboard)

kind.description: Detected from the page when omitted

reason.description: What the person should do, shown to them, e.g. 'Sign in to example.com'

targetId.description: Tab to use: a targetId from browz_tabs_list. Default: the first tab

timeoutSec.description: How long to wait for the person. Default 300

name: browz_request_human
title: Hand to a person
